title: Count Digits in a Number
description: Count the number of digits in a positive integer using recursion.

data.text: Given a positive integer `n`, count the number of digits in it.
Divide by 10 until reaching the base case (0). Each division removes one digit. O(log n) time.

data.title: Recursive O(log n)
data.content: Divide by 10 until reaching the base case (0).

data.text: Loop dividing by 10 and counting steps. O(log n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Iterative O(log n)
data.content: Loop dividing by 10 and counting steps.

data.text: Convert to string and return length. O(log n) time, O(log n) space for the string.

data.title: String Conversion O(log n)
data.content: Convert to string and return its length.

data.title: What improved?
data.text: All three approaches are O(log n) because the number of digits grows logarithmically with `n`. The iterative version avoids recursion stack overhead.
